fusions.name: Weighted Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted mesh that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Drawstring
fusions.desc: Pulls a line of cord 5 tiles long taut for 6 seconds. It deals 11 damage to each enemy that crosses it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Bait and Tangle
fusions.desc: Draws up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds while it holds.

fusions.name: Knots Tighten
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 4. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for 30% of your weapon damage per strand (120% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 5 seconds.
